declarations.name: AuiTooltip
declarations.description: AbsoluteUI Tooltip on its trigger: `<button auiTooltip="Opens the help center">`.

inputs.name: tooltipRelation
inputs.description: Trigger gets aria-describedby ('description') or aria-labelledby ('label', for icon-only controls).

inputs.name: tooltipPlacement
inputs.description: Preferred side and logical alignment; flips and shifts to fit.

inputs.name: tooltipShowDelay
inputs.description: Hover delay before showing, ms. Keyboard focus shows immediately.

inputs.name: tooltipHideDelay
inputs.description: Delay after the pointer leaves the trigger and tooltip before hiding, ms.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: After the tooltip became visible (dispatched on the tooltip element).

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show the tooltip now (without the hover delay).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tooltip pattern, with WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus.

limitations: Touch pointers never show the tooltip; tooltips must not hold essential information.
Disabled native buttons receive no pointer or focus events, so their tooltips never show; use aria-disabled instead.
Only one tooltip is visible at a time per loaded copy of the module.
The tooltip is appended to the end of the body, or to the trigger's enclosing <dialog> so it stays hoverable while a modal dialog makes the rest of the page inert.
The gap between trigger and tooltip is fixed at 6px.
